prompt: What was state of the schools regarding integration in the hometown of Miller Williams when he began his master's degree in Zoology?
answer: When Miller Williams began his master’s in zoology—around 1951–52—the public schools in his Arkansas hometown, Hoxie, were still segregated. This was before *Brown v. Board of Education* (1954); Hoxie did not begin integrating its schools until 1955. His father’s opposition to segregation later became visible during the 1957 Little Rock school-integration crisis.
